title: Celebrating Our New Zealand Scholarship Recipients
body:
Congratulations to our Rosehill College students on their outstanding success in the **New Zealand Scholarship** examinations.

* **Theana Chen**

   — Outstanding Scholarship in Accounting
* **Annabelle Foo**

   — Outstanding Scholarship in Accounting
* **Spencer Ha**

   — Scholarship in Accounting
* **Bob Luu**

   — Scholarship in Physics

New Zealand Scholarships recognise the country's highest-achieving secondary school students. Around three percent of candidates receive a Scholarship Award, while Outstanding Scholarships are awarded to only a small number of students who demonstrate exceptional performance.

These achievements reflect not only academic excellence, but also perseverance, curiosity, and a genuine commitment to learning. We are incredibly proud of Theana, Annabelle, Spencer, and Bob, and congratulate them on this well-deserved recognition.

We look forward to following their future successes and wish them every best for the journey ahead.
